why_best: Carrying an identical focal point through an instantaneous view shift instantly proves that the incoming interface is a direct downstream result of the user's trigger.
why_bad: Fading or sliding the whole viewport would make a high-efficiency developer environment feel sluggish and blur the relationship between action and output.
trap: A near-miss will slightly misalign the scale or position at the instant of the swap, turning an elegant continuity beat into an annoying visual glitch.
